BiblicalUsage: Madmenah was a place in Benjamin, named once, in Isaiah 10:31, where Madmenah is removed and the inhabitants of Gebim gather themselves to flee before the Assyrian advance. Gebim gathers itself to flee in the same verse, and Madmenah is one of the towns emptied by the advance.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that Isaiah 10:31 is a snapshot of panic: one town after another empties as the enemy comes down the road.
